phrases.latin: omnis enim ambulātiō lapidem aliquem reddit, quō fit ut pater sinūs lapidibus plēnōs domum referat
phrases.english: for every walk yields some stone, and so Dad brings home pockets full of stones

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
